name: nTSWorld::cWallVertex::cWallVertex
notes: Constructor(pos): vtable, id -1, position copied as three dwords (NaN bits kept), first 0, count 0. Test WallVertex_Constructors over blocks prefilled 0/0xcd/0x5a/0xff, result pointer compared. Lane VR (WL-0d). Three routes per case: the original by RVA, ours through our vtable, and the adapter on a game-vtable object (trap in the slot where the adapter must not dispatch); the vertex and every edge of the rig dumped and compared.
